limitations: Convenience sample from first 500 sorted PDB entities per length band.

prepared.grouping: Connected components: shared Pfam OR BLOSUM62 global alignment (gap open 10, extension 0.5), identity >=30% of alignment columns, paired-residue coverage >=80% of longer sequence, length ratio >=0.8. Remote homology may remain.
